name: Huymaier Console FSE Shell, Storefront & Artwork Integration
features: rebuilds N64 as an original Huymaier cartridge-console surface inspired by the supplied classic-mini reference without redistributing third-party theme assets
renders the GameCube IPL hub as a translucent animated WPF 3D cube whose Game Play, Calendar, Memory Card, and Options faces rotate spatially with navigation
reworks Wii and Wii U menus around authentic channel/software presentation and integrates real emulator/data/library settings into those console surfaces
removes nonfunctional Wii, Switch, and Xbox service placeholders and keeps only actions that Huymaier Console can actually perform

routes emulator executable, data, and game-folder selection through Huymaier Consoles controller-first native file browser and offers latest supported emulator installation when no emulator is attached
resolves console cover art from emulator/data caches first, then Huymaier cache and online console artwork fallbacks without renaming or moving user ROMs
repairs Steam artwork so installed and owned entries prefer Steam local art, then Steam-hosted portrait art, then a deterministic cached nonblank fallback

preserves v0.26.2 Game Bar and Guide ownership, launch-return behavior, storefront/provider fixes, installer integrity, and controller navigation while keeping PS1, PS2, and PS3 visuals frozen except for shared path/install handoff
keeps LB/RB out of normal page and selection navigation on the redesigned non-PlayStation native console interfaces
description: v0.26.3 RC3 is the authentic-console, emulator-integration, navigation, and artwork pass built from the published v0.26.2 baseline. PS1/PS2/PS3 presentation remains frozen; their emulator/data/library path choices now hand off to Huymaier Console native picker.
